title: Sawe smashes two-hour barrier to make sporting history at the 2026 TCS London Marathon
claims: Sabastian Sawe won the 2026 TCS London Marathon in 1:59:30, the first official marathon under two hours.
Yomif Kejelcha finished second in 1:59:41 and Jacob Kiplimo third in 2:00:28.
The report says three men finished inside the previous world record.
The leading group reached halfway in 60:29.
Amos Kipruto finished fourth in 2:01:39 and Tamirat Tola fifth in 2:02:59.
Mahamed Mahamed was the first Briton home in 2:06:14, with Patrick Dever next in 2:06:18.
